A Tale of Two Charcadet | POKÉTOON Short
Two wild Charcadet are inseparable friends—even though one has a Gentle Nature and the other has a Naughty Nature, they have lots of fun together. But one day, a Pokémon Trainer appears, and the Naughty Charcadet leaves alongside him... Lonely and confused, the Gentle Charcadet sets out to search for its friend in this fiery yet bittersweet story about the evolution of friendship.
